directions.observation_decision: Read the route under a supporting bridge, choose a lateral departure direction, then deliberately remove the support beneath oneself.
directions.causality: A horizontal original ShotLatch gate supplies actual body support while closed. Shooting the original bell removes that support and commits the player to falling into a newly opened lower route.
directions.resource_world_change: Permanent world collision changes from supporting bridge to open shaft; not a temporary gate sprint.
directions.necessary_terrain: Rock limits the useful bell line of sight to the bridge position. Lower exit is offset and cannot be reached by dropping around the intact bridge.
directions.original_cell_binding: ShotLatch.setup arbitrary gate Rect2 and original gate collision_layer=1/0; same actual player motor.
cheap_counters: shoot from safe bank then approach
open while airborne from any easier point
directions.family_boundary: Do not force recoil/airborne words. If the result is only shoot-to-open-floor then walk forward, reconsider puzzle depth, but the self-removal of support is distinct from timed-cache and brake-under-ledge.

directions.observation_decision: Read a moving slab relative to enemy fire, then stop it where it can shield a ground route rather than serve as a ride.
directions.causality: Original ModuleMovingPlatform is an AnimatableBody2D on collision layer1. Original EnemyAttackProjectile sweeps mask1 and is disposed on nonplayer collision. Original ShotLatch.bind_motion can stop the slab at a useful blocking position.
directions.resource_world_change: Player changes persistent location of physical cover; subsequent projectile reaches slab instead of player.
directions.necessary_terrain: Player must cross a line-of-fire region that has no static cover and cannot be bypassed by killing/shooting from safety at lower cost.
directions.original_cell_binding: All three bindings read from actual source; no projectile deletion or artificial hit-ignore.
directions.family_boundary: Unlike chase-landing, no support/ride is needed; unlike closing-shield, cover placement is a player-controlled spatial variable instead of automatic gate closure. Needs real interception evidence and legitimate unshielded alternatives.

directions.observation_decision: Expose the player on one side of a blocking charger, make it commit away from the desired crossing, then pass through the body space it vacated during recovery.
directions.causality: Original EnemyAttackBehavior locks brain.direction at telegraph entry and charger moves toward home.x plus signed patrol_half_width; it then has a real recovery period. Movement must change physical occupancy, not simply dodge a projectile.
directions.resource_world_change: A living threat is repositioned by its own committed attack rather than player hit knockback or death.
directions.necessary_terrain: An alcove allows the player to get around the committed charge while enemy body otherwise blocks the narrow target passage.
directions.original_cell_binding: Original plains_charger is already permitted by PlainsCells. Important: charger requires floor under its leading foot and EnemyMotor has no gravity; do not propose luring it into a pit or synthetic falling death.
cheap_counters: wait for any phase without bait
directions.family_boundary: Different from telegraph-underpass only if relocating the enemy body is necessary, not merely an alternate timing cue. Compare against live-knockback-aperture too; voluntary enemy motion versus shot motion alone is insufficient unless player must choose an exposing lure position and exploit recovery.

directions.observation_decision: Attach high on a wall while a hazard crosses the side exit; decide when to kick away before continuing descent makes the exit unreachable.
directions.causality: Original wall_attach sets wall_slide_limit=wall_fall_speed(75); it does not stop the body and no stamina expenditure was found. The player has both a hazard phase constraint and a monotonically decreasing launch-height budget.
directions.resource_world_change: Height is spent while observing. Waiting indefinitely is impossible even though wall-jump readiness may remain available.
directions.necessary_terrain: Finite high wall, lower failure zone, side target requiring sufficient launch height, and original moving saw crossing that departure route.
directions.original_cell_binding: Original TraversalAbility.wall_attach/wall_jump, original saw, actual body coordinates and HP.
cheap_counters: wait at entry then identical safe jump
single wall kick without saw timing
climb back up for unlimited observation
directions.family_boundary: Unlike grapple/hang-phase, the observation position is not stable and time changes remaining reachable space. If entrance waiting perfectly replaces wall timing or single-wall relaunch freely restores height, merge/reject rather than count a saw added to wall jumping.

non_directions: Extra ordinary intermediate islands: serial segments, not a family.
Same reaction with different resource name: restoration source alone not a family.
Adding a saw to an existing route: not a family without new observation/decision.
More hooks, doors, shots, enemies, or boxes: counts do not establish a new player decision.
